facts.fact: 洛琳从高柜里取出一个大礼袋，放到基特面前的台面上，基特愣住，不敢相信那是给自己的生日礼物。
facts.anchor: until she pulls out a large gift bag and sets it on the counter in front of me.

facts.fact: 洛琳让基特放心拆礼物享用，说那个“蠢男人”若有意见就当面跟她讲，她不许他再毁掉基特的生日。
facts.anchor: If that silly man has anything to say about it, he can say it to my face. I am not letting him ruin your birthday any further.

facts.fact: 生日贺卡上没有索伦的名字，基特为此莫名难受，觉得索伦甚至不知道有这张卡。
facts.anchor: But… Soren’s name isn’t there; he probably doesn’t even know the card exists.

facts.fact: 基特问洛琳“索伦为什么恨我”。
facts.anchor: The thought drags me straight back to Soren, and before I can stop myself the question slips out. “Why does Soren hate me?”

facts.fact: 索伦问洛琳是否照例要三月的整整一周独处，用来纪念她丈夫。
facts.anchor: I presume you want the usual week to yourself in March, for your husband?

facts.fact: 索伦的声音比平时低沉、几乎带着小心，说“生日快乐，克里斯托弗”。
facts.anchor: His voice comes out deeper than usual, almost careful. “Happy birthday, Christopher.”

facts.fact: 索伦用肩膀顶住基特胸口、手臂勾住他大腿，把他整个人扛到肩上。
facts.anchor: he bumps his shoulder into my chest, hooks an arm around my thighs, and hauls me clean over his shoulder.

facts.fact: 基特小声嘟囔“我们刚刚才做过”，索伦听见了并纠正说那是大约十五小时之前。
facts.anchor: He catches it anyway. “No, that was about fifteen hours ago.”
